title: polish(app-showcase): color + sublabels on home & My Work KPI tiles
body:
The landing KPIs rendered with the neutral grey icon (`object-metric`'s default `colorVariant`) and an empty card bottom — flat. Opt them into the metric palette + add a one-line sublabel so tiles are colorful and informative:

- **Home** — Projects (blue), Tasks (purple), Accounts (teal), Open Tasks (amber)
- **My Work** — Open Tasks (blue), In Review (amber), At-Risk (rose)

Each gains a `description` (active & planned / not done / awaiting review / …) that fills the previously-empty space. Pairs with objectui [#1817](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/1817) (`tabular-nums` on the value). Browser-verified on `:5181`; 20 tests pass.
